summary: Annovis Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 7, 2026, announcing full enrollment in its pivotal Phase 3 trial evaluating buntanetap for early Alzheimer's disease. The trial enrolled 850 patients across 83 US sites, exceeding original projections. This is a clinical milestone announcement, not a special situation (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign). The filing is a routine current report on other events and does not involve any corporate transaction or structural change. No deal terms apply.
